bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made a notable trade Tuesday, agreeing to acquire a 2027 fifth-round pick and defensive back Clark Phillips III from the Atlanta Falcons in exchange for defensive lineman Gervon Dexter Sr., pending physicals. The team also made several other roster moves, as they activated linebacker Keyshaun Elliott and defensive back Elijah Hicks, signed linebacker Antonio Hicks, placed linebacker Nephi Sewell on Reserve/Injured, and signed defensive lineman Marcus Davenport and defensive back Deantre Prince while waiving running back Coleman Bennett and tight end Nikola Kalinic.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions are heading into their bye week after beating the Arizona Cardinals, with WR Jameson Williams having his fines rescinded after a celebration crack down in Week 2 . The team is also dealing with injury concerns, as they are expected to lose WR/RET Tom Kennedy to a season-ending injury , while head coach Dan Campbell addressed how to approach the bye week in his Monday press conference.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers suffered a significant blow on defense as the team lost DT Javon Hargrave to a torn Achilles on Sunday, prompting them to work out former Patriots DT Isaiah Iton as they scan the market for defensive tackle help . This comes as Green Bay looks to build on its dominant 31-7 win over the Bears, with the Packers having held Ben Johnson's Bears offense to seven points and 246 yards before facing a challenging Week 6 road matchup against the Detroit Lions .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings improved to a surprising 5-0 start after a 23-13 road win over the New Orleans Saints, a game in which Kyler Murray's growth with the team "was predictable," with the offense trending in the right direction after three full starts into the Murray era heading into their bye week. With the team now boasting one of the biggest surprises in the NFL this season at 5-0 on the backs of a historic defense , attention has turned to the trade deadline, as the Vikings are expected to be aggressive in building a Super Bowl caliber roster .
